# ============================================================
# Namespace
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: n8n
---
# ============================================================
# Secrets
# Replace placeholder credentials before deploying.
# PostgreSQL admin and application usernames must be different.
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: n8n-secrets
  namespace: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: "changeUser"
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "changePassword"
  POSTGRES_DB: "n8n"
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER: "n8n_user"
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD: "changeAppPassword"
  RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN: "changeRunnerAuthToken"
  N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: "replace-with-a-long-random-encryption-key"
---
# ============================================================
# ConfigMap - PostgreSQL Initialization Script
# Runs only when the database is first initialized.
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: postgres-init
  namespace: n8n
data:
  init-data.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -eu

    if [ -n "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER:-}" ] && \
       [ -n "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then

      psql \
        -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
        --username "$POSTGRES_USER" \
        --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" \
        -v app_user="$POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER" \
        -v app_password="$POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
        -v db_name="$POSTGRES_DB" <<'EOSQL'

    SELECT format(
      'CREATE ROLE %I WITH LOGIN PASSWORD %L',
      :'app_user',
      :'app_password'
    )
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'app_user'
    )
    \gexec

    GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE :"db_name"
      TO :"app_user";

    GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA public
      TO :"app_user";

    EOSQL

    else
      echo "SETUP INFO: No application database credentials provided!"
    fi
---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL PersistentVolumeClaim
# StorageClass: cluster default
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: postgres-pvc
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
# ============================================================
# n8n PersistentVolumeClaim
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: n8n-pvc
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL Service
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: postgres
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
      protocol: TCP
---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL Deployment
# PostgreSQL 18
#
# IMPORTANT:
# PostgreSQL 18 requires a database migration when upgrading
# from PostgreSQL 16 or 17. Do not reuse an older major
# version's data directory without a proper migration.
# ============================================================
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: postgres
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: postgres
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:18
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
              protocol: TCP

          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: n8n-secrets

          env:
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data

          volumeMounts:
            - name: postgres-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data

            - name: postgres-init
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-data.sh
              subPath: init-data.sh
              readOnly: true

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "2"
              memory: 2Gi

          startupProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - |
                  pg_isready \
                    -h 127.0.0.1 \
                    -U "$POSTGRES_USER" \
                    -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60

          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - |
                  pg_isready \
                    -h 127.0.0.1 \
                    -U "$POSTGRES_USER" \
                    -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - |
                  pg_isready \
                    -h 127.0.0.1 \
                    -U "$POSTGRES_USER" \
                    -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6

      volumes:
        - name: postgres-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: postgres-pvc

        - name: postgres-init
          configMap:
            name: postgres-init
            defaultMode: 0755
---
# ============================================================
# n8n Service
# Port 5678: Web UI / API
# Port 5679: External Task Runner Broker
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: n8n
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 5678
      targetPort: 5678
      protocol: TCP

    - name: task-broker
      port: 5679
      targetPort: 5679
      protocol: TCP
---
# ============================================================
# n8n Deployment
# Version: 2.43.5
# Uses PostgreSQL and External Task Runners
# ============================================================
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1

  strategy:
    type: Recreate

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: n8n

    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60

      # Wait for PostgreSQL to accept authenticated connections
      # using the n8n application database credentials.
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:18
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          env:
            - name: PGHOST
              value: postgres

            - name: PGPORT
              value: "5432"

            - name: PGDATABASE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_DB

            - name: PGUSER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER

            - name: PGPASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD

          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until psql -w -X -tAc 'SELECT 1' | grep -q 1; do
                echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL authentication..."
                sleep 5
              done
              echo "PostgreSQL is ready."

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi

      containers:
        - name: n8n
          image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:2.43.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 5678
              protocol: TCP

            - name: task-broker
              containerPort: 5679
              protocol: TCP

          env:
            # Database configuration
            - name: DB_TYPE
              value: postgresdb

            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST
              value: postgres

            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT
              value: "5432"

            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_DB

            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER

            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD

            # External task runners
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED
              value: "true"

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_MODE
              value: external

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS
              value: "0.0.0.0"

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT
              value: "5679"

            # Application configuration
            - name: N8N_HOST
              value: "0.0.0.0"

            - name: N8N_PORT
              value: "5678"

            - name: N8N_PROTOCOL
              value: "http"

            - name: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY

            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: production

            - name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
              value: Asia/Karachi

            - name: TZ
              value: Asia/Karachi

            - name: N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED
              value: "false"

          volumeMounts:
            - name: n8n-storage
              mountPath: /home/node/.n8n

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "2"
              memory: 2Gi

          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 5678
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz/readiness
              port: 5678
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 5678
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch

      volumes:
        - name: n8n-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: n8n-pvc
---
# ============================================================
# n8n External Task Runner Deployment
# Version must match the main n8n version.
# Broker connection uses internal Kubernetes service DNS.
# ============================================================
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n-runner
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: n8n-runner
spec:
  replicas: 1

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n-runner

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: n8n-runner

    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30

      containers:
        - name: n8n-runner
          image: n8nio/runners:2.43.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          env:
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secrets
                  key: RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
              value: "http://n8n:5679"

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
---
# ============================================================
# External Access
#
# Access n8n through a NodePort service.
# Replace this with an Ingress or LoadBalancer when deploying
# behind a production HTTPS endpoint.
#
# Node IP:  <KUBERNETES_NODE_IP>
# NodePort: 30678
#
# URL: http://<KUBERNETES_NODE_IP>:30678
#
# The task broker port 5679 remains internal to the cluster.
# ============================================================
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: n8n-external
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: n8n
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 5678
      targetPort: 5678
      nodePort: 30678
      protocol: TCP
